changes.implementation: Static source-frame adapter now encodes the measured target range through the common sensor-range/mm representation before shared endpoint classification. Native input is retained.
changes.regression: test_static_surface_consistency uses distinct real patches and submillimetre residuals through selectStaticFrames.

changes.implementation: Centre projection accepts finite positive Z and checks floating pixel bounds before integer conversion. Candidate geometry uses forward sphere-ray intersection; only a sphere wholly behind the camera can be skipped.
changes.regression: test_session_refusion directly applies production estimator to old8cm face with valid50cm rays or missing rays.

changes.implementation: State inspector reads explicit CURRENT marker, using native interval only for legacy nodes; historical nodes and identities have separate fields. Canonical fingerprint still includes complete causal snapshot.
changes.regression: Causal seed test retains closed metadata while native current queries remain absent.

changes.implementation: Motion and hidden-change fixtures use actual accepted trajectories, current-state markers and eligible distinct spatial/pixel evidence; old contradictory expectations aligned with existing shared classification.

Shared hasSessionCurrentState is used by inspector, viewer and test summaries; composeSessionCurrentMesh filters only its temporary view before native geometry composition. Legacy closed mesh remains stored but is not displayed as current; selected snapshot time is returned by shared causal query.
changes.regression: testLegacyCurrentGeometryProjection covers legacy closed mesh, preserved history, explicit state priority and between-snapshot time selection.
